text:
hana-rel: Heads-up: canary blocked in ap-northeast. Deploy-bot: `promotion blocked - preinstall hook failed (hook: annotate-release)`

greg.ops: I pulled the hook log. Error: `failed to patch release annotations: conflict - resource version mismatch`. It appears two overlays set the same `release.annotations` key to different values.

hana-rel: Chart bump to v1.8.0 added a global `release.annotations.promoted-by` default in templates. That collides with per-tenant overlays that also set `promoted-by`.

olivia-eng: Exact error snippet:
```
PreInstallHook annotate-release: patching release annotations
Error: Operation cannot be fulfilled on releases "auth": the object has been modified; please apply your changes to the latest version and try again
Exit status 1
```

paul-sre: Impact: promotion paused for ap-northeast and eu-west. No pods failed, but the Helm release is stuck mid-upgrade. EU change window in 35m.

nate-pm: Options: 1) pin chart back to v1.7.4 and re-run promotion (fast), 2) attach per-release override to unset the chart default annotation (no chart publish), 3) quick chart patch v1.8.1 removing default annotation (~40m). Which is lowest-risk?

greg.ops: Attaching an override to explicitly set `release.annotations.promoted-by` in the release values to a stable canonical string will avoid the race. That avoids publishing. It's reversible and quick.

hana-rel: Sounds good. We should also record the decision in release notes and file a follow-up to remove defaults from chart templates.

olivia-eng: Override snippet I used locally:
```yaml
release:
  annotations:
    promoted-by: "redwood-deploy"
```
This ensures overlays won't collide when Helm patches annotations.

greg.ops: I'm applying per-release override to groups: ap-northeast, eu-west now.

deploy-bot: applying per-release values override -> service/auth@2026-04-12-110

deploy-bot: promotion resumed -> re-queueing groups (ap-northeast, eu-west)

olivia-eng: Canary re-ran in ap-northeast and preinstall hook succeeded. Annotation applied without conflict. :white_check_mark:

nate-pm: Release notes text suggestion: "Temporarily applied per-release values to avoid annotation key collision introduced by auth chart v1.8.0 (default release.annotations.promoted-by). We have pinned values per-release for the affected batches; a chart patch v1.8.1 will remove the templated default and add a CI preflight to detect annotation defaults."

paul-sre: Follow-ups: 1) PR to chart to remove default `release.annotations.*` in templates (target v1.8.1), 2) CI preflight rule to warn when chart templates render global release annotations, 3) add runbook note about annotation race failures and pin-vs-override decision tree.

hana-rel: I'll open the PR and create tickets. Also adding a short blurb to release notes before we close this.

greg.ops: overrides attached; I'm keeping them until v1.8.1 canary is promoted.

deploy-bot: promotion complete -> groups promoted successfully (ap-northeast, eu-west)

hana-rel: closing thread  follow-ups filed. Thanks team :heart:
